d:
Mava kek ka sahi reshiyo: 1 kap dudh, 2 kap maida – bina ovan, batar
Masala Kitchen by Poonam Devnani men gais par banne vale spanji kek ki puri resipi.
sahi reshiyo: 1 kap dudh, 1/3 kap tel, derh kap pisi chini, 2 kap maida
mava nahin hai? 1/4 kap milk paudar se vahi svad
7 inch tin men ooncha aur 8 inch men chaura kek
karhaee men 40-45 minat, ya ovan men 180C par 35-40 minat
Kament men bataie – aap mava dalengi ya milk paudar?
